chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala' ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them), who said:

I asked him about the prayer of the eclipse during the time of the obligatory prayer, so he said: 'Begin with the obligatory prayer.' It was said to him: '(What if it was) at the time of the night prayer?' So he said: 'Pray the eclipse prayer before the night prayer.'

key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْكُسُوفِ: Prayer of the eclipse (solar or lunar)

ai.seo_question: What is the order of prayer when an eclipse occurs during the time of an obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the hierarchy between the specific sign-based prayer of the eclipse and the fixed-time obligatory prayers, establishing that the eclipse prayer takes precedence over the night prayer (Salat al-Layl) but yields to the primary Fard. This ruling reflects the Shia scholarly view that Salat al-Kusuf is a distinct, time-sensitive act of worship triggered by the celestial event, requiring immediate attention when it overlaps with voluntary or secondary obligatory timings. The distinction highlights the flexibility in Shia jurisprudence regarding the ordering of prayers based on the urgency of the sign versus the fixed schedule of daily obligations.

en.hubeali: From him, from Muhammad Bin Al-Husayn, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Al-A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5th or 6th Imamasws), said, ‘I asked himasws about Salāt of the eclipse during a time of the Obligatory (Salāt). So heasws said: ‘Begin with the Obligatory (Salāt)’. So it was said to himasws, ‘(Supposing it was) at the time of the night Salāt?’ So heasws said: ‘Pray the Salāt of the eclipse before the night Salāt’.
en.sarwar: 5. It is a narration from him (narrator of previous Hadith) by Muhammad ibn af-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from af-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following: “I once asked one of the two Imam, ‘Alayhim al-Salam, about performing Salah (prayer) because of eclipse at the time of obligatory Salah (prayer). He (the Imam) said, ‘Begin with obligatory Salah (prayer).’
He (the Imam) was asked, ‘Can it be performed in the time of nightly optional Salah (prayer)?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘Perform Salah (prayer) because of eclipse before nightly optional Salah (prayer).”’
